purpose: Terran Authority Assembly exterior conveying institutional power and an expectation of compliance
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished cinematic exterior architectural concept for Stellar Syndicates.
Primary request: The TERRAN AUTHORITY ASSEMBLY building, designed to communicate overwhelming institutional authority and an expectation of obedience. Continue the exact elegant ivory-stone, amber-light, navy-and-antique-gold aesthetic of the preceding Authority concepts. Convey the message through architecture and scale, without written slogans.

References: Image 1 is the primary MATERIAL, LIGHTING and STYLE reference: beautiful pale weathered mineral stone, curved monumental architecture, broad circular cornices, narrow warm amber windows, navy banners, gold insignia, restrained realistic finish. Create a NEW monumental assembly building, a fundamentally different silhouette and composition from that coastal citadel. Image 2 is the official Authority emblem: a thin antique-gold orbital ring intersected by three slender vertical spires with staggered heights. Integrate that recognizable emblem into the façade and banners.

Subject and architecture: An immense, imposing seat of galactic government overlooking a vast formal civic plaza. A colossal central cylindrical Assembly chamber rises above a high, tiered stone podium; its enormous circular crown projects outward as a thick sculpted disc. The upper drum is rhythmically divided by towering, austere ivory piers and deeply recessed vertical amber-lit slots. Strong, rounded stepped administrative wings extend symmetrically from the rotunda, held together by continuous horizontal stone terraces and heavy curved cornices. The massing feels stable, permanent and immovable. The entrance is a single profoundly recessed monumental portal at the center of a huge expanse of pale stone, approached by a succession of broad ceremonial stairs. A very large, precise gold Authority seal stands above the portal. Four long, still navy banners hang between the monumental piers, carrying only the gold emblem. No names, letters or slogans.

Psychology and scale: The visitor is made to feel small before an institution that expects compliance. Use strict axial order, immense unbroken masses, long controlled sight lines, the hierarchy of raised terraces, austere repetition, a single unmistakable route to the entrance and almost intimidating amounts of empty space. The building should be beautiful, stern and commanding. Broad bronze-edged stairs and low geometric walls direct entry; tiny, disciplined pairs of ivory-armored sentries stand at the upper threshold. A small number of delegates in dark formal clothing ascend in orderly groups, dwarfed by the structure. The people are merely scale cues; the exterior architecture is the subject.

Setting: A monumental outdoor plaza of matte pale stone with shallow dark reflecting pools to either side of a wide uninterrupted central processional way. Restrained wind-shaped trees at the far outer edges, dwarfed by the architecture. The Assembly sits on a foundation of exposed dark bedrock with faint blue-grey mountain silhouettes beyond the capital district. The formal plaza meets that landscape naturally. No lakefront mansion composition.

Composition: ONE landscape image, approximately 3:2. Full exterior establishing shot from a low pedestrian vantage at the far end of the ceremonial approach, centered axis, convincing 28–35mm architectural perspective with near-vertical walls. The building fills most of the frame, with its entire circular crown, main wings and stair base visible. Strong leading lines draw the viewer toward the immense gold seal and deeply recessed entrance. Wide foreground gives a felt sense of the intimidating approach. Not aerial, not an interior, not a miniature model, no cropped roof.

Materials and lighting: Tactile, subtly weathered ivory limestone and off-white mineral concrete, fine stone pores and soft rain streaks, dark navy-glass recesses, restrained brushed brass. Warm amber light glows from very narrow architectural slots and beneath the cantilevered cornices. Cool pearl-grey overcast late-day sky, blue-grey atmosphere, softly reflective pools, gentle realistic shadows. Maintain the reference's luminous stone and quiet sophistication, even while making the mood much more authoritarian. High-end cinematic photorealism with natural exposure and restrained contrast.

Avoid: excessive ornament, busy machinery, gratuitous spikes, black fortress styling, generic glass skyscrapers, domed classical capitol imitation, overt military battle, propaganda text, labels, UI, collage, watermark or border. One cohesive image, no variants or contact sheet.
